name: 02114 · Boston, MA
findings: ZIP 02114 (Boston) has 159 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 52 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02114 (Boston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02114 (Boston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
